question: What was Sergei's career before becoming an AI/LLM engineer?

question: What is the Autonomous Trading Floor project about?
answer:
**Autonomous Trading Floor** (August 2026)

An equity trading simulation where four autonomous LLM agents manage virtual portfolios. They research the market, execute trades, and rewrite their own strategies based on how their past trades performed. It is built on the Model Context Protocol and the OpenAI Agents SDK, with a FastAPI backend and a Vite/TypeScript dashboard.

- [Live demo](https://trading-floor.duckdns.org/)
- [Code on GitHub](https://github.com/Neuromediator/autonomous-trading-floor)

question: What is the Tennis Match Research Dashboard project about?
answer:
**Tennis Match Research Dashboard** (June to July 2026)

An LLM agent project on a real domain. For every upcoming ATP and WTA tour-level singles match, the dashboard shows four independent signals side by side: market consensus odds, a trained LightGBM probability, a surface-Elo baseline and an LLM-discovered news block. When the model and the market differ by more than 10 percentage points, a deterministic panel explains why.

The project demonstrates end-to-end ML and LLM engineering: data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, LLM tool calling and a deployable interface. It is built with LightGBM, Python, Streamlit, Tavily, Docker and DuckDB, and runs on HF Spaces. It is not a betting tool.

- [Live demo](https://huggingface.co/spaces/Neuromediator/tennis-research-dashboard)
- [Code on GitHub](https://github.com/Neuromediator/Tennis-Match-Research-Dashboard)

question: What is the Avatar project about?
answer:
**Avatar** (September to October 2026)

A digital twin with a human in the loop: a chat where visitors talk to an AI version of me. It answers from my profile and FAQ, streams its replies, and sends a notification to my phone when a question needs me. From an admin dashboard I can join any conversation, which makes it a three-way chat between the visitor, the AI and me.

It is built with the OpenAI Agents SDK, a FastAPI backend, Supabase and a Vite/TypeScript frontend. It is deployed to Fly.io through GitHub Actions and embedded in my personal website.

- [Live demo](https://sergeimaslennikov.com/avatar/)
- [Code on GitHub](https://github.com/Neuromediator/avatar)
